may_skip_if: The user explicitly requests to skip.
The PR is a no-op (no code change, no test change, no doc change).
The PR is a CI rerun or a backport.
may_not_skip_if: A guardrail is added or removed.
A pilot / external review / paid pilot artifact is affected.

summary.next_expected_branch: After 53F (mid-phase refresh) or a broader 53A-53I refresh branch (B35+) when the user requests it

global_notes: The cadence plan is conservative. Agent B refreshes only when the cadence point is reached. Agent B does not refresh speculatively or pre-emptively.
The five mandatory refresh points are: After 53B, After 53D, After 53F, After 53G, After 53J closeout. Agent B may add optional refresh points if the user requests them.
Claude review / post-51T review are separate workstreams. They are referenced only as review evidence, not external validation or certification.
